provenance.basis: Four independent structural cold ASI clones of pre-product string-core-oracle.json ASI case. Existing StringFacts allows nonempty well-formed names and logical paths with CR/BS/FF; the fourth legal name contains literal backslash+r/b/f/u001b and keeps a path without backslashes. Facts/HIR identities use published crypto preimages; Source, codeUnits and ranges remain unchanged. Complete expected Core uses original independent ASCII ASI template with explicit MLIR hex byte escapes, never product output.

expectedRed.kind: Natural whole-Core mismatch after all complete facts/HIR controls. CR first reaches current shared quote defect; later comparisons get no RED execution credit unless actually reached.
expectedRed.forbidden: Do not restrict accepted name/path domain, regenerate expected from new output, catch mismatch as success or claim Source/guest execution.
